precedence.when: the task is specifically about financial provenance or what a financial evidence source may authorize
the movement is specifically hypothesized to be between accounts inside the same portfolio boundary
the question is specifically whether a portfolio return may be published or how it should be measured
multiple downstream analytics need domain-specific readiness gating
the task is specifically proving disposal cost basis from acquisition lots
the records may contradict each other but no mutation has been authorized or designed yet
the task explicitly requires correcting or mutating financial history after diagnosis
a wrong UI value may originate from shared state, data authority, or sibling consumers
underlying data is already proven correct and the problem is hierarchy, interaction, or operational presentation
the work would cross an unauthorized protected boundary
a human decision is already settled and the only issue is carrying it forward
the work has not started and needs a bounded task contract
a concrete patch or PR already exists and must be checked against its contract

falsifier: Run the routing benchmark across real model/runtime combinations. Any repeatable confusion that contradicts this policy is evidence to change the policy or skill descriptions, not to hide the miss.
